column3: “a sabbath rest” renders “a sabbath of sabbath observance (shabbaton).”
“aftergrowth” renders “safiah,” self-sown grain, “untrimmed vines” renders “nazir,” unpruned vines, and “a sabbatical year” renders “a year of shabbaton.”
“the sabbath products of the land” renders “the sabbath of the land.”
“sound … abroad” renders “cause to pass through,” and “a ram’s horn” renders “a shofar of loud blast (teru’ah).”
“a release” renders “deror,” liberty, and “his family” renders “his clan.”
“your friend” renders “your fellow (amit),” and “wrong one another” renders “maltreat each his brother.”
“In proportion to” renders “according to the mouth of” (twice).
“a fellow countryman of yours” renders “your brother” (also in verses 35–36, 39 and 47), and “his nearest kinsman” renders “his redeemer (go’el) who is near to him.”
“kinsman” renders “go’el (redeemer),” and “recovers his means” renders “his hand reaches.”
“he has not found sufficient means” renders “his hand has not found sufficiency.”
